item.title: XG redefine their name from Xtraordinary Girls to Xtraordinary Genes in bold new chapter

item.title: BoA & SM Entertainment part ways after 25 years marking a new chapter for the K-pop legend
item.description: After more than two decades together, BoA and SM Entertainment have officially parted ways. SM Entertainment announced on 12 January that BoA’s exclusive contract with the company concluded on 31 December, following thorough discussions between both parties. item.title: BTS announce 2026–2027 world tour: Singapore, Manila, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok & more confirmed
item.description: BTS are back on the road — and they’re gearing up for their biggest world tour yet. The K-pop icons have just revealed the cities and dates for their 2026–2027 world tour, which will include 79 shows across 34 cities, with stops in Singapore, Manila, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, and more.
